name: Simple extras
author: Joe-ai example
about: An example add-on: a black-and-white copy of pictures and videos (with the FFmpeg Joe already uses), and a word count for text files (a small Python script inside the add-on).

tools.blurb: A black-and-white copy of a picture or video.
